rules.statement: Section 41 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance (No. 8 of 1905) does not preclude a temple, or any duly authorized representative of the temple for that purpose, from acquiring title to any land by prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 41 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance (No. 8 of 1905) does not preclude a temple, or any duly authorized representative of the temple for that purpose, from, acquiring title to any land by prescription.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, No. 8 of 1905, s. 41
